title: Flock Safety Transparency Portal & Vehicle Exclusion
author: board
summary: The HOA has published a new Flock Safety Transparency Portal and is now allowing residents to request exclusion of their vehicle from the HOA’s searchable Flock results. Requests require HOA approval and residency verification. Click to view details and request exclusion.
body:
The HOA has published a new Flock Safety Transparency Portal and is now offering residents the ability to request that their vehicle be excluded from the HOA’s searchable Flock results.

Resident exclusion requests are not automatically approved. Each request will remain pending until residency can be reasonably verified by the HOA or property management company.

Transparency Portal:
https://transparency.flocksafety.com/towne-properties-hoa-oh

Resident Vehicle Exclusion Request:
https://users.flocksafety.com/authorized-access-list/1ab875e2-182b-42a0-a36e-7a6808024575/public

Residents requesting exclusion should use the same name and email address associated with their property whenever possible. If a request cannot be verified from existing records, property management may contact the resident using the contact information already on file.

The Flock cameras were originally installed following vehicle break-ins in the neighborhood. Since installation, those incidents have significantly decreased. The goal is to maintain those security benefits while also providing residents with greater transparency and a reasonable privacy option.

title: Flock Safety Cameras Installed
author: board
body: Flock Safety (license plate) cameras have been installed at each entrance to Kable's Mill. They are accessible by Sugarcreek PD. This addition serves as another proactive measure to enhance the security and well-being of our community.
